description: This file contains the implementation of the UserRoleRepository class, responsible for managing user-role relationships in the database, including adding roles to users, removing roles, and retrieving role names by user ID.

classes.name: UserRoleRepository
classes.description: Repository class for handling database operations related to user roles, such as assigning roles, removing roles, and fetching role names.

methods.name: addRoleToUser
methods.description: Associates a role with a user in the database by inserting into the user_roles table, ignoring if the relationship already exists.

methods.name: removeAllRolesForUser
methods.description: Deletes all role associations for a specified user from the user_roles table.

methods.name: findRoleNamesByUserId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of role names associated with a specific user ID by joining roles and user_roles tables.
